text: Sõber kirjutab: „Ta jõi hommikul kaks tassi kohvi.“ Kes need tassid ära jõi?
gloss: A friend writes: 'Ta drank two cups of coffee this morning.' Who drank them? — A man or a woman: Estonian 'ta/tema' has no gender, so the sentence doesn't say. 'Several people' is ruled out by the singular.

text: Lauses „Homme ma sõidan Tartusse“ räägitakse tulevikust. Mis ajavormis on aga tegusõna „sõidan“?
gloss: 'Tomorrow I drive to Tartu' is about the future. But what tense is the verb 'sõidan'? — Present: Estonian has no future tense and uses the present; 'future' is the autopilot trap.

text: Kui sõnas „kõrv“ võtta õ-lt ära tilde, mis asjaks kõrv muutub?
gloss: Take the tilde off the õ in 'kõrv' (ear): what does the ear turn into? — A basket: 'korv'.

text: Vabariigi aastapäeva õhtul vaatab pool Eestit teleris presidendi vastuvõtul kätlemist. Mis kuupäeval see on?
gloss: On the evening of Independence Day half of Estonia watches the handshakes at the President's reception on TV. What date is it? — 24 February (1918 declaration). 20 August is the Restoration of Independence Day, 2 February the Tartu Peace Treaty anniversary, 16 November the Declaration of Sovereignty (1988).

text: Millest valmistatakse kama, mida segatakse keefiri või hapupiimaga?
gloss: What is kama, stirred into kefir or sour milk, made of? — A flour of roasted grains (barley, rye, oats) and peas.

text: Millest seotakse Eestis kõige sagedamini saunaviht?
gloss: What is a sauna whisk most often bound from in Estonia? — Birch twigs (oak and juniper are rarer; spruce, pine and rowan aren't the usual ones).

text: Millises riigis maksetakse zlottides?
gloss: In which country do people pay in złoty? — Poland. Czechia has the koruna, Hungary the forint, Romania the leu.

text: Millist lahte ületab laev, mis sõidab Tallinnast Helsingisse?
gloss: Which gulf does the ferry from Tallinn to Helsinki cross? — The Gulf of Finland.

text: Millise Eestis leiutatud spordiala harrastaja teeb jäikade vartega kiigel täispöörde ümber võlli?
gloss: In which sport invented in Estonia does the athlete swing a full circle around the axle on a swing with rigid arms? — Kiiking (Ado Kosk, 1990s). Pesäpallo is Finnish.

text: Mis tüüpi pill on eesti rahvapill kannel?
gloss: What type of instrument is the Estonian folk instrument kannel? — A string instrument (a zither, kin to the Finnish kantele).

text: Milline Eestis asutatud firma pakub äpis taksosõite ja renditõukerattaid?
gloss: Which company founded in Estonia offers taxi rides and rental scooters in its app? — Bolt (founded as Taxify by Markus Villig). Wolt is Finnish, Uber and Lime American.

text: Kes jõuab Oskar Lutsu „Kevade“ esimestel lehekülgedel isaga kooli, kui tunnid on juba alanud?
gloss: Who arrives at school with his father on the first pages of Luts's 'Spring', after lessons have begun? — Arno Tali: 'Kui Arno isaga koolimajja jõudis, olid tunnid juba alanud.'

text: Millisel spordialal tuli Ott Tänak 2019. aastal maailmameistriks?
gloss: In which sport did Ott Tänak become world champion in 2019? — Rally (WRC, with co-driver Martin Järveoja).

text: Kes on eesti muinasjuttudes jõuline, aga rumal kurat, keda Kaval-Ants ikka ninapidi veab?
gloss: Who is the strong but stupid devil of Estonian folk tales whom Crafty Ants always fools? — Vanapagan (Old Heathen).

text: Vastlapäeval lastakse mäest liugu. Mida pidi pikk liug rahvauskumuse järgi kasvatama?
gloss: On Shrovetide people sledge downhill. What was a long slide believed to make grow? — Long flax.

text: Mis oli Eesti rahaühik enne eurole üleminekut 2011. aastal?
gloss: What was Estonia's currency before the switch to the euro in 2011? — The kroon (1992–2010). The mark was used 1919–1927, the litas is Lithuanian.

text: Mida teeb arvutis klahvikombinatsioon Ctrl+Z?
gloss: What does Ctrl+Z do on a computer? — Undoes the last action. Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+C copies.

text: Riiete hooldussildil on pesukausi sees number 30. Mida see tähendab?
gloss: A care label shows a washtub with 30 in it. What does it mean? — Wash at up to 30 °C.

text: Miks puistatakse talvel jäistele teedele soola?
gloss: Why is salt spread on icy roads in winter? — Salt water freezes at a lower temperature, so the ice melts. Grit, not salt, makes ice rough.

text: Mis tuleb tennise punktilugemises pärast 15 ja 30?
gloss: What comes after 15 and 30 in tennis scoring? — 40. 45 is the tempting 'logical' step.

text: Mida teeb muusikaäpis nupp, millel on kaks ristuvat noolt?
gloss: What does the button with two crossing arrows do in a music app? — Shuffle: plays the tracks in random order. Repeat is a looped arrow.

text: Millises sarjas hakkab keemiaõpetaja Walter White narkootikume valmistama?
gloss: In which series does chemistry teacher Walter White start making drugs? — Breaking Bad (2008–2013).

text: Millest tehakse tofut?
gloss: What is tofu made from? — Soybeans (curdled soy milk). Chickpeas make hummus.

text: Milline puu kannab sügisel punaseid marjakobaraid, mida rästad ja siidisabad talvel meelsasti nokivad?
gloss: Which tree bears clusters of red berries in autumn that thrushes and waxwings love to peck in winter? — The rowan. The bird cherry (toomingas) has black berries, lilac and horse chestnut no berries at all.

text: Miks pärmitainas kerkib?
gloss: Why does yeast dough rise? — Yeast ferments the sugars and gives off carbon dioxide, whose bubbles puff up the dough.

text: Millises arvutimängus kaevandatakse ja ehitatakse maailmu kuubikutest?
gloss: In which computer game do you mine and build worlds out of cubes? — Minecraft.

text: Milline anonüümne tänavakunstnik lasi oma maali „Tüdruk õhupalliga“ kohe pärast oksjonimüüki hekseldada?
gloss: Which anonymous street artist had his painting 'Girl with Balloon' shredded right after it sold at auction? — Banksy (Sotheby's, London, 2018); it became 'Love is in the Bin'.

text: Jope maksab 80 eurot ja sellelt tehakse 25% allahindlust. Mis on uus hind?
gloss: A jacket costs 80 euros and is 25% off. What is the new price? — 60 euros: a quarter of 80 is 20. 55 subtracts 25 euros instead of 25%.

text: Kahe miljoni inimese käest kätte kett ulatus Tallinnast Vilniuseni. Mis aastal Balti kett toimus?
gloss: A chain of two million people holding hands stretched from Tallinn to Vilnius. In which year was the Baltic Way? — 1989 (23 August).

text: Kes võitis 2001. aastal koos Dave Bentoni ja 2XL-iga Eestile Eurovisiooni lauluvõistluse?
gloss: Who won Eurovision 2001 for Estonia together with Dave Benton and 2XL? — Tanel Padar ('Everybody').

text: Kellele kuulub Eesti isikukood, mis algab numbritega 490…?
gloss: Whom does an Estonian personal ID code starting 490… belong to? — A woman born in 1990: the first digit 4 means a woman born in the 1900s (3 a man), the next two digits are the year.

text: Mida tähendab toidupakendil märge „Parim enne“?
options: Pärast seda kuupäeva on toit ohtlik
Toit tuleb ära süüa avamise päeval
Kuni selle ajani on kvaliteet tagatud
gloss: What does 'Best before' on a food package mean? — Quality is guaranteed until then; the food is often fine after it. The safety deadline is 'Kõlblik kuni' (use by).

text: Mitu käänet on eesti keeles?
gloss: How many grammatical cases does Estonian have? — 14 (Finnish has 15, Russian 6).

text: Kes kirjutas romaanid „Rehepapp“ ja „Mees, kes teadis ussisõnu“?
gloss: Who wrote the novels 'Old Barny' and 'The Man Who Spoke Snakish'? — Andrus Kivirähk.

text: Milline Tallinna loss ehitati Peeter I käsul ja sai nime tema abikaasa Katariina järgi?
gloss: Which Tallinn palace was built on Peter the Great's orders and named after his wife Catherine? — Kadriorg Palace (Kadriorg = 'Catherine's valley', Catharinenthal).

text: Välk sähvatas ja müristamine kostis 3 sekundit hiljem. Kui kaugel on äike?
gloss: Lightning flashed and the thunder came 3 seconds later. How far away is the storm? — About 1 km: sound travels about 340 m a second, light arrives almost instantly.

text: Mida tähendab, kui e-kirja saaja on lisatud „Bcc“-väljale?
gloss: What does it mean when an e-mail recipient is in the Bcc field? — The other recipients can't see them (blind carbon copy).

text: Millise riigi koosseisu kuulub maailma suurim saar Gröönimaa?
gloss: Which country is Greenland, the world's largest island, part of? — Denmark (the Kingdom of Denmark, with self-rule).

text: Mis on mesilasperes emamesilase peamine töö?
gloss: What is the queen bee's main job in a colony? — Laying eggs (up to about 2,000 a day); the workers gather nectar, guard and build comb.

text: Kui pikk on jäähokis üks kolmandik?
gloss: How long is one period in ice hockey? — 20 minutes of playing time.

text: Mis oli kreeka mütoloogias jumalate toit, mis tegi sööja surematuks?
gloss: What was the food of the gods in Greek mythology that made its eater immortal? — Ambrosia. Manna is biblical, soma the Vedic drink, mõdu (mead) Norse.

text: Mis nimi oli „Tähesõdade“ Darth Vaderil enne pimedale poolele minekut?
gloss: What was Darth Vader's name before he turned to the dark side in Star Wars? — Anakin Skywalker. Luke is his son.

text: Johannes Aavik lõi eesti keelde mõne sõna täiesti tühjast. Milline neist on tema tehtud?
gloss: Johannes Aavik invented some Estonian words out of thin air. Which of these is his? — 'Relv' (weapon), one of his artificial words; the others are old native words.

text: Täiskuu on Maast vaadates Päikese vastas. Millal ta umbes tõuseb?
gloss: The full Moon is opposite the Sun as seen from Earth. When does it rise? — Around sunset: as the Sun sets in the west, the opposite point of the sky comes up in the east.

text: Millise Rootsi valitseja ajal asutati 1632. aastal Tartu ülikool?
gloss: Under which Swedish ruler was the University of Tartu founded in 1632? — Gustav II Adolf (his statue stands behind the main building). Kristina succeeded him that same year.

text: Milline Aafrika riik on ainus, kus üks ametlikest keeltest on hispaania keel?
gloss: Which African country is the only one with Spanish as an official language? — Equatorial Guinea, a former Spanish colony. Angola is Portuguese-speaking, Gabon French, Cameroon French and English.

text: Mida tähendab veebiaadressi alguses oleva „https“ lõpus olev s?
gloss: What does the s at the end of 'https' stand for? — Secure: HTTP over an encrypted (TLS) connection.

text: Kuu on Maast umbes 384 000 km kaugusel. Kui kaua liigub sealt Maale raadiosignaal?
gloss: The Moon is about 384,000 km away. How long does a radio signal take from there to Earth? — About a second (1.3 s): radio waves travel at the speed of light, about 300,000 km/s. 8 minutes is sunlight's trip.

text: Kes on Kadrioru rannas seisva Russalka mälestusmärgi autor?
gloss: Who made the Russalka memorial on the Kadriorg shore? — Amandus Adamson (1902). The others are Estonian sculptors too.

text: Riias sündinud ja Tartus õppinud Wilhelm Ostwald sai 1909. aastal keemia Nobeli auhinna. Mille uurimise eest?
gloss: Wilhelm Ostwald, born in Riga and educated at Tartu (Dorpat), won the 1909 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. For research into what? — Catalysis (and chemical equilibria and reaction rates). Radioactivity: Rutherford 1908; noble gases: Ramsay 1904; isotopes: Soddy 1921.
